entries.proposition: THE CASE CNV IS NOT A CANONICAL-EXON DELETION by the paper's own description: it involves the last exon of the two shorter WWOX transcripts. Mapped against Ensembl GRCh37 (reader's computation), the interval lies inside canonical intron 5.
entries.snippet: deletion involving the last exon of the two shorter gene transcript variants of the WWOX gene (NM_130791.3 and NR_120436.1)
entries.anchor: Results, 'Rare inherited copy number variants in ASD candidate genes'

entries.proposition: COORDINATES AND ZYGOSITY of the case: a 58,751 bp heterozygous loss, inherited from one parent, in a boy with high-functioning PDD-NOS, normal IQ, normal EEG and MRI.
entries.anchor: Table S5 (sheet 'Table S5'), the WWOX row

entries.snippet: M24=High functioning PDD-NOS | N24=PDD-NOS on ADOS and ADI-R; normal IQ on WISC-IV (TIQ 115); normal EEG and brain MRI

entries.proposition: A CONTROL CARRIES A HETEROZYGOUS WWOX LOSS: array call at chr16:78,386,295-78,466,632, which on Ensembl GRCh37 spans canonical exons 6 and 7 and most of exon 8 (reader's computation). Not in the qPCR-validated list; boundaries are array estimates.
entries.anchor: Table S3 (sheet 'Table S3', rare CNVs), the control WWOX row

entries.proposition: WHO THE CONTROLS ARE: adults without psychiatric history recruited at a headache centre for a nicotine study; no neurological or EEG assessment is described.
entries.snippet: without psychiatric history, recruited at the Division of Toxicology and Clinical Pharmacology, Headache Centre

entries.proposition: THE AUTHORS' WWOX INFERENCE rests on one case and a citation, and proposes a weak-risk role for heterozygous variants. No WWOX-specific test statistic is reported.
entries.snippet: Rare CNVs overlapping WWOX have been reported at greater frequency in ASD cases versus unaffected controls6, thus suggesting that WWOX heterozygous variants act as weak risk factors, generally associated with milder ASD phenotypes, as in our case.

entries.proposition: Figure 3 panel d inspected: the case deletion (proband and transmitting parent) and the control deletion are drawn as non-overlapping red bars over the 5' part of WWOX; the control bar lies further 3', nearer 78.4-78.47 Mb.
entries.snippet: [figure attestation - pixels cannot be quote-matched] Figure 3 panel d 'chr16 (q23.1-q23.2)': two red bars near 78.30-78.36 Mb under Probands and Parents; one red bar under Controls near 78.39-78.47 Mb, not overlapping them; WWOX transcript tracks below.

entries.proposition: The qPCR-validated set is a selected subset of 31 CNVs in three categories, with parents tested; controls are not named among them.
entries.snippet: These included three categories: (i) 5 putative genic de novo CNVs, (ii) 11 CNVs deemed relevant
entries.anchor: Supplementary Methods, Validation of CNV calls
